skins.label: Rainy Day Records
skins.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a richly painted SQUARE illustration atlas for an existing Colt Radio player, premium friendly equine mascot illustration with tactile materials and cinematic cozy lighting. ARTWORK ONLY, not a UI mockup. Exact THREE horizontal regions: TOP y=0–33% detailed scenic banner with NO HORSE or people; instruments and decorative objects at far sides, open dark central space for real HTML title. MIDDLE y=33–53% blank dark theme material, central x=7–93% uncluttered texture, narrow decorative vertical rails only along leftmost/rightmost 7%. BOTTOM y=53–100% exactly ONE friendly anatomically equine Colt HORSE head-and-shoulders portrait, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, centered x=50%, character occupies x=22–78%, ears and headwear fully visible with breathing space above, shoulder to bottom. Head begins below y=55%, long horse muzzle, natural mane, kind expressive eyes, real horse ears, no human hands or face. Clothed shoulders, readable portrait at small size. Sharp straight horizontal boundaries between three atlas regions. No extra horses, no text, lettering, logos, numbers, music-note symbols, UI labels, baked buttons or watermark. THEME RAINY DAY RECORDS: a cozy independent vinyl record shop on a rainy afternoon. TOP: rain-streaked tall window showing soft sage/gray-blue street reflections; walnut record bins full of unlabeled vinyl sleeves at far left, a beautiful turntable with copper tonearm and warm small reading lamp at far right, cozy wood shelving, warm amber interior lighting, open central space. No coffee cups as focal point, no animals in banner. MIDDLE: deep muted FOREST-SAGE woven speaker cloth, narrow WALNUT-grain side rails with small aged brass fittings, no illustrations in center. BOTTOM: beautiful SEAL-BROWN/dark bay horse with a warm tan muzzle and small natural cream forehead star, soft dark espresso mane, subtle tortoiseshell reading glasses fitted appropriately to horse face, thick CREAM cable-knit sweater with a muted sage collar, relaxed welcoming expression. No hat or headphones. Warm amber rim light keeps face visible against forest-green background. Palette walnut, sage, cream, aged brass; intimate analog record-store warmth.
